{{color box|#2F488B|border=darkgray}} [[Bangsamoro Federalist Party|BFP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Maguindanao del Sur's at-large congressional district''' refers to the lone [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Maguindanao del Sur]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since the province's creation in 2022. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Esmael Mangudadatu]] of the [[Partido Federal ng Pilipinas]] (PFP) and [[Bangsamoro Federalist Party]] (BFP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=September 19, 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/php-tpls-attachments/2025NLE/COC_2025NLE/CLC2025_BARMM/MAGUINDANAODELSUR_OPES.pdf|title=Certified List of Candidates (PROVINCIAL) - Maguindanao del Sur|accessdate=January 3, 2025|publisher=Commission on Elections}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" colspan="2" | # ! colspan="2" | Member ! colspan="2" | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history |- !Image !Name !Start !End |- | colspan="9" style="text-align:center;" | ===Maguindanao del Sur's at-large district for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]=== |- | colspan="9" style="text-align:center;" | District created September 18, 2022. |- | style="text-align:center;" rowspan="2" | '''1''' | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|Nacionalista Party}};" | | rowspan="2" | [[File:Rep.
